pictures.caption: NOAA OVATION aurora forecast for the northern hemisphere, model run 2026-09-25 15:55 UTC (the time it forecasts, printed on the map, is 30-90 min later): where aurora is likely, green to red = 10% to 90% chance. A model map, not a photograph.
